organization.name_ja: スターバックス コーヒー ジャパン 株式会社

affected.note: About 31,500 employees in the initial 2025-09-19 announcement, plus about 40,700 more employees' IDs found leaked in a 2025-10-03 follow-up; ScanNetSecurity reports the combined total as about 72,200. The data was taken from a data transfer system used by Blue Yonder for its Work Force Management shift scheduling SaaS. Only employee information was reported as affected.

summary.en: Starbucks Coffee Japan said employee personal data leaked after a cyberattack on Blue Yonder, provider of the Work Force Management shift scheduling tool it uses. About 31,500 employees were initially affected, and a follow-up found employee IDs of about 40,700 more, for a total of about 72,200.
summary.ja: スターバックス コーヒー ジャパンは、同社が利用するシフト作成ツール「Work Force Management」を提供するBlue Yonder社へのサイバー攻撃により、従業員の個人情報が漏えいしたと公表した。当初の約31,500名に加え、続報で約40,700名分の従業員IDの漏えいが判明し、合計は約72,200名となった。
